title: Measuring, Interpreting, and Improving Fairness of Algorithms using Causal Inference and Randomized Experiments
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not benchmark anything related to faith or religion. It proposes a framework to measure disparate treatment, disparate impact, and economic value in algorithmic systems using sensitive attributes like race, gender, and age.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of its analysis. The analysis focuses entirely on fairness related to other sensitive attributes like race, gender, and age.
